name: RAG MCP Server - VS Code Extensions Lock
description: Lock file for reproducible VS Code extension installation

essential.name: ESLint
essential.description: Integrates ESLint JavaScript into VS Code

essential.name: MCP Extension
essential.description: Model Context Protocol support for VS Code

essential.name: EditorConfig for VS Code
essential.description: EditorConfig Support for Visual Studio Code

essential.name: YAML
essential.description: YAML Language Support by Red Hat

recommended.name: npm Intellisense
recommended.description: Autocompletes npm modules in import statements

recommended.name: esbuild problem matchers
recommended.description: Problem matchers for esbuild errors and warnings

recommended.name: PostgreSQL
recommended.description: PostgreSQL management tool for VS Code

recommended.name: Error Lens
recommended.description: Improve highlighting of errors, warnings and other language diagnostics

recommended.name: Pretty TypeScript Errors
recommended.description: Make TypeScript errors prettier and human-readable

recommended.name: Todo Tree
recommended.description: Show TODO, FIXME, etc. comment tags in a tree view

recommended.name: Better Comments
recommended.description: Improve your code commenting by annotating with alert, informational, TODOs, and more!

optional.name: Docker
optional.description: Makes it easy to build, manage, and deploy containerized applications

optional.name: GitHub Pull Requests and Issues
optional.description: Pull Request and Issue Provider for GitHub

optional.name: Git Graph
optional.description: View a Git Graph of your repository, and perform Git actions from the graph

installationScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Install all extensions from lock file
cat > install-extensions.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Essential extensions
code --install-extension dbaeumer.vscode-eslint@3.0.21
code --install-extension esbenp.prettier-vscode@12.1.0
code --install-extension eamodio.gitlens@2026.1.1504
code --install-extension block.vscode-mcp-extension@0.2.0
code --install-extension mtxr.sqltools@0.28.5
code --install-extension editorconfig.editorconfig@0.17.4
code --install-extension redhat.vscode-yaml@1.19.1

# Recommended extensions
code --install-extension christian-kohler.npm-intellisense@1.4.5
code --install-extension connor4312.esbuild-problem-matchers@0.0.3
code --install-extension ckolkman.vscode-postgres@1.4.3
code --install-extension redis.redis-for-vscode@1.4.0
code --install-extension alefragnani.project-manager@13.0.1
code --install-extension streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker@4.4.0
code --install-extension usernamehw.errorlens@3.26.0
code --install-extension yoavbls.pretty-ts-errors@0.7.0
code --install-extension visualstudioexptteam.vscodeintellicode@1.3.2
code --install-extension gruntfuggly.todo-tree@0.0.226
code --install-extension aaron-bond.better-comments@3.0.2
code --install-extension tamasfe.even-better-toml@0.21.2
EOF
chmod +x install-extensions.sh
./install-extensions.sh
